assumption.1: expected long-term return on plan assets
assumption.2: initial cash balance crediting rate assumed for the next year
assumption.3: rate to which the cash balance crediting rate is assumed to increase/decrease (the ultimate rate)
assumption.4: year that the cash balance crediting rate reaches the ultimate rate
assumption.6: initial health care cost trend rate assumed for the next year
assumption.7: rate to which the health care cost trend rate is assumed to decline (the ultimate trend rate)
assumption.8: year that the health care cost trend rate reaches the ultimate trend rate
